  "selected_outcome_reason": "Select the Ninja Luxe Café Premier for $599.99, leaving $200.01 below the ceiling. Its explicit integrated grinding and hands-free milk workflow best match two beginner-made morning milk drinks. Cheaper offers carry greater functional or quality uncertainty; higher-priced offers do not establish enough additional satisfaction.",
  "strategic_response": "Bing narrowed its final list to two integrated offers and placed Premier first. Google added a cheaper AutoFroth variant while retaining several integrated alternatives. These choices can keep revenue within each provider's own list. Neither supplied the requested standalone grinder or accessories, limiting useful cross-provider component bundles. First-round persistence preserved cheaper competitors despite later omissions. No hidden catalog availability or intention can be inferred, and ordering, repeated cards and ratings provide no independent confirmation. The selected simulated purchase attributes 59999 cents to Bing and zero to Google.",
  "material_assumptions": [

    "Automatic whole-bean espresso systems are treated as providing integrated grinding and brewing; no additional scale or upgraded accessories are required.",
    "Merchant labels and advertised returns provide limited positive evidence, not confirmation of the actual contracting seller or enforceable recourse."
  ],
